figurative_meaning_en: To create intense controversy or excitement
example_sentences_in_bangla: সোশ্যাল মিডিয়ায় এই খবর তুফান তোলার কারণ হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His speech in the meeting stirred up a storm.
This news on social media has created a storm of controversy.
note: This idiom draws from natural imagery of storms to metaphorically represent social or verbal turbulence.
